summary.headline: Marcianus 314 and 323 Contents
summary.text: Descriptions and folio contents of Marcianus codices 314 and 323, including Ptolemy’s Tetrabiblos, commentaries by Porphyry and Achmetes, works by Theon, Diophantus, and Vettius Valens, and methods for calculating eclipses and lunar and solar cycles.
